title: Eat the Pinned Pawn First
setup: Black's pawn, queen and king are stacked on the d-file, one behind the other, and both your rooks are looking up it.
hint: The pawn cannot move forward. Count what happens if you start at the front of the pile.
explanation:
## The Idea

The pawn on d6 blocks both your rooks. {{Rxd6}} removes it, and now the queen on d7 is pinned to the king behind it. {{Qxd6}} is Black's only way to avoid losing the queen for nothing, and {{Rxd6+}} takes back with the second rook: a rook for a pawn and a queen, leaving a rook against a bare king.

Start at the front of a pile only when something of yours stands behind to take back.
